text:
maria: quick Q — customer reported weird latency spikes on dedicated eu-west-prod pools. Where do I pull the per-pool autoscale and saturation graphs?

alex: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/pool-metrics?orgId=1&var-pool=eu-west-prod :eyes:

maria: thanks! which panels specifically should I look at for 'saturation' vs 'throughput'?

alex: start with these: 'pool_utilization' (GPU load), 'requests_per_gpu', 'p95_token_latency', and 'kv_cache_hit_ratio'. saturation is basically util >= 0.8 + growing queue depth.

jing: if you need raw signals, use Prometheus queries from the dashboard. e.g.:
```
sum(rate(redwood_pool_requests_total{pool="eu-west-prod"}[1m])) by (pool) / sum(redwood_pool_gpus_count{pool="eu-west-prod"}) by (pool)
```
that gives reqs/sec per GPU -> compare vs target throughput.

sam: also watch the steal queue metric: `redwood_pool_steal_queue_depth`. short sustained spikes there correlate with preemption/ooms.

maria: got it. I also saw an alert ping this morning for pool-saturated-eu-west. observability-bot, can you paste the alert details?

observability-bot: ALERT: pool-saturated-eu-west fired at 2149990800. Trigger: `pool_utilization_p90 > 0.85` for 5m. Affected: eu-west-prod-1, eu-west-prod-2. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/pool-saturation

maria: hmm trigger at 0.85 seems aggressive given recent load variance. Is that threshold historic or new?

alex: that was tuned last quarter to catch tail latency issues. But for Dedicated, we sometimes need a higher threshold to avoid noise. I proposed 0.9 in the alert PR but didn't get full signoff.

jing: if you want to test adjustments, we can create a temporary alert override for this customer and monitor for 24h. I can patch in a canary threshold rule: `>0.9 for 10m` and route notifications to #eng-platform-testing.

maria: please do. Also: can someone point me to where traces for slow requests land? I want sample trace ids to correlate with p95 spikes.

sam: traces are in Tempo, query via Grafana trace panel. If you have a request id you can search `request_id:abcd1234`. Otherwise sample from the slow span panel in the p95 dashboard.

maria: ok doing that now. one more — where are kv cache eviction logs? I'm trying to see if cache thrashing coincides.

alex: Loki stream: {app="kvcache", pool="eu-west-prod"} `level=warn` and `evict` in message. Quick link: https://loki.redwood.ai/explore?query=%7Bapp%3D%22kvcache%22%2Cpool%3D%22eu-west-prod%22%7D%20|%3D%22evict%22

jing: tl;dr checklist for triage: 1) grafana panel list (util, reqs/gpu, p95, steal_queue, kv_hit). 2) prom queries for raw signals. 3) logs in Loki for evicts. 4) traces in Tempo. 5) adjust alert threshold to 0.9 canary -> monitor 24h.

maria: perfect. alex/jing can you push the temporary alert canary? leave the PR link here when done.

alex: on it, will open PR and add unit tests for rule eval. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/observability/pulls/248

sam: ping me in the PR if you want me to run synthetic load against eu-west-prod to validate. I can spin a short ramp. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — I'll collect a couple trace ids and paste here after initial triage.

alex: PR merged to staging, will roll to prod after validation.

observability-bot: NOTE: change-request queued for alert-rule pool-saturated-eu-west, change: threshold 0.85->0.9 (canary). Requested by alex at 2149991350.

maria: awesome. leaving this thread open for follow-ups. :wave:
